department: Aggarwal Department of Physics and Optical Science

deadline.value: Fall applications completed before March 1 get the highest consideration for assistantships and tuition funding; the final deadline is August 1.
deadline.quote: Highest consideration for assistantships and tuition funding for fall term admission is given to applications completed before March 1st

gre_general.value: A combined verbal and quantitative score of 301 is required, but waived for UNC Charlotte graduates from the past three years with a 3.4 GPA in the major.
gre_general.quote: A minimum combined score of 301 on the verbal and quantitative portions of the GRE revised General Test

also.quote: The GRE General Test requirement is waived for applicants who have graduated from UNC Charlotte within the past three years and earned a minimum 3.4 GPA in the major

funding.value: Beginning students are usually supported by teaching assistantships; the page does not say every admitted student is funded.
funding.quote: Support for beginning graduate students is usually a teaching assistantship

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's degree in physics, chemistry, mathematics, engineering, optics or a related field with the GPA rules is accepted.
entry_route.quote: A Baccalaureate or Master’s degree in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Engineering, Optics, or a related field

notes: Offered by the Physics and Optical Science department (Fall and Spring starts). The university's physics record is this program because it is the only physics-field PhD found. Department pages give no TOEFL or IELTS minimum; the Graduate School rules apply.
name: Optical Science and Engineering, Ph.D.
